metrics.name: Debt to Equity
metrics.description: Period-end gross interest-bearing debt, before cash offsets, over period-end shareholder equity, in one reporting scope and currency. Zero debt is a valid zero. A dimensionless multiple. Unavailable when an input is missing or the denominator is zero or negative. Covenant thresholds and definitions are agreement-specific and are not part of this metric.

metrics.name: Debt to Assets
metrics.description: Period-end gross interest-bearing debt, before cash offsets, over period-end total assets, in one reporting scope and currency. Zero debt is a valid zero. A dimensionless multiple. Unavailable when an input is missing or the denominator is zero or negative. Covenant thresholds and definitions are agreement-specific and are not part of this metric.

metrics.name: Equity Multiplier
metrics.description: Period-end total assets over period-end shareholder equity, in one reporting scope and currency. A dimensionless multiple. Unavailable when an input is missing or the denominator is zero or negative. Covenant thresholds and definitions are agreement-specific and are not part of this metric.

metrics.name: Debt to EBITDA
metrics.description: Period-end gross interest-bearing debt, before cash offsets, over trailing-twelve-month EBITDA. EBITDA is the shared reported-cost `fin.ebitda`. The trailing window must be complete: an incomplete or gapped window is unavailable. Zero debt is a valid zero. A dimensionless multiple. Unavailable when an input is missing or the denominator is zero or negative. Covenant thresholds and definitions are agreement-specific and are not part of this metric.

metrics.name: Interest Coverage
metrics.description: Trailing-twelve-month EBITDA over trailing-twelve-month statement interest expense. `interest_expense` is the interest recognized in the income statement, including recognized PIK, as a positive expense. EBITDA is the shared reported-cost `fin.ebitda`; a negative EBITDA gives a negative coverage. Both trailing windows must be complete. A dimensionless multiple. Unavailable when an input is missing or the denominator is zero or negative. Covenant thresholds and definitions are agreement-specific and are not part of this metric.

metrics.name: Debt Service Coverage
metrics.description: Trailing-twelve-month EBITDA over trailing-twelve-month scheduled cash debt service on borrowings. `scheduled_cash_interest_due` and `scheduled_principal_due` are the scheduled cash interest and the scheduled principal (amortization and maturity) recognized once on their contractual due dates, whether or not they were paid; they exclude arrears settlements, advance payments, prepayments and sweeps, PIK, fees, hedge flows and distress cash. With a capital structure they are `cs.scheduled_cash_interest_due.total` and `cs.scheduled_principal_due.total`. EBITDA is the shared reported-cost `fin.ebitda`; a negative EBITDA gives a negative coverage. Both trailing windows must be complete. A dimensionless multiple. Unavailable when an input is missing or the denominator is zero or negative. Covenant thresholds and definitions are agreement-specific and are not part of this metric.
